title: Clone a GitHub Repo
description: Pull a project from GitHub down to your machine so you can start coding.

steps.instruction: Open a GitHub repo in your browser and copy the HTTPS clone URL
hints: Click the green 'Code' button and copy the URL under 'HTTPS'

steps.instruction: Open a terminal (Terminal on macOS, iTerm2, or your shell of choice)
hints: On Windows: Win+S → 'Terminal' or use Git Bash

steps.instruction: cd to where you want the repo, then run `git clone <URL>`
hints: Paste the URL you copied — git will create a folder for you
If it asks for credentials, enter your GitHub username + a personal access token
